title: The golden changes the first discount period from 0.75 to 0.75/2 = 0.375 but keeps +1 increments, so it is not a valid mid-year convention: the next midpoint should be 1.25, not 1.375. Nothing in the prompt or file signals the change, and every PV, DCF output and Cover!G10 depends on it.
